title: Process Optimized
description: PROCESS Optimized Pack, deeply tuned for low-end GPUs, delivering stable 300-512 FPS with full technical redstone support, bringing smooth Minecraft 1.21.10 gameplay to aging hardware.
body:
## 📖 详细描述 | Detailed Description

### 起源 | Origin

**中文：**
清流优化整合包诞生于一个简单而迫切的需求：让老旧硬件重新焕发生机。在这个显卡价格飞涨的时代，不是每个人都能拥有最新的 RTX 4090。GTX 960、RX 570 这些曾经的"甜品卡"，如今被归类为"低端"，但它们真的无法流畅运行 Minecraft 了吗？

我不这么认为。

经过三个月的反复测试、调整和优化，PROCESS 诞生了。它不是为了追求极致画质，而是为了在有限硬件条件下，实现最流畅的游戏体验。每一个模组的选择，每一项配置的微调，都只有一个目标：让帧数更高一点，让卡顿更少一点。

**English:**
PROCESS Optimized Pack was born from a simple yet urgent need: to breathe new life into aging hardware. In an era of soaring GPU prices, not everyone can afford the latest RTX 4090. Cards like the GTX 960 and RX 570, once considered "sweet spot" options, are now labeled "low-end"—but do they really struggle to run Minecraft smoothly?

I don't believe so.

After three months of relentless testing, tweaking, and optimization, PROCESS was born. It doesn't chase visual perfection; it pursues the smoothest possible gameplay on limited hardware. Every mod selection, every configuration fine-tune serves one goal: push the FPS higher, reduce stutter further.

---

### 优化哲学 | Optimization Philosophy

**中文：**
清流的优化不是简单的"堆模组"。市面上很多所谓的"优化整合包"只是盲目堆砌几十个性能模组，结果互相冲突，反而更卡。我采用的原则是"精准打击"——只安装确实有效的模组，每一项都有明确的作用和测试数据支撑。

渲染管线是重点。Minecraft 的默认 OpenGL 实现效率低下，Sodium 彻底重构了这一层，配合 ImmediatelyFast 的批量渲染，将绘制调用减少到原来的十分之一。方块实体是另一个痛点，箱子、告示牌、旗帜这些看似简单的方块，实际上每个都是独立的渲染对象。ebe newer 和 FastChest 将它们优化为普通方块渲染，FPS 提升立竿见影。

**English:**
PROCESS isn't about blindly "stacking mods." Many so-called "optimized modpacks" haphazardly throw together dozens of performance mods, causing conflicts and worse performance. My approach is "surgical precision"—only install mods with proven effectiveness, each backed by clear purpose and testing data.

The rendering pipeline is the primary target. Minecraft's default OpenGL implementation is inefficient; Sodium completely reconstructs this layer, combined with ImmediatelyFast's batch rendering, reducing draw calls to one-tenth of the original. Block entities are another pain point—chests, signs, and banners, seemingly simple blocks, are actually independent render objects. ebe newer and FastChest optimize them to render as ordinary blocks, delivering immediate FPS gains.

---

### 生电友好 | Technical Friendly

**中文：**
优化不等于阉割。很多优化包为了帧数，砍掉了生电（生存红石）必需的功能。完整保留了 Carpet 全家桶、Litematica 投影、WorldEdit 等核心工具。你仍然可以建造百万效率的刷怪塔，设计复杂的红石计算机，只是现在帧数更高了。

箱子商店的优化是个典型例子。原版 Minecraft 中，100 个箱子密集摆放会让 FPS 暴跌到 70。通过 ebe newer 的方块实体优化和分层设计建议（展示框前台+箱子后台），现在可以稳定 150+ FPS，既保留了商店功能，又保证了流畅度。

**English:**
Optimization doesn't mean compromise. Many optimization packs sacrifice essential technical survival-redstone features for FPS. PROCESS fully preserves the complete Carpet suite, Litematica schematics, WorldEdit, and other core tools. You can still build million-efficiency mob farms and design complex redstone computers—just with higher FPS now.

The chest shop optimization exemplifies this. In vanilla Minecraft, 100 densely packed chests crash FPS to 70. Through ebe newer's block entity optimization and layered design (item frame frontend + chest backend), it now maintains stable 150+ FPS, preserving shop functionality while ensuring smoothness.

---

### 用户体验 | User Experience

**中文：**
从启动到游戏，每一个环节都经过打磨。ModernFix 和 LazyDFU 将启动时间缩短一半；Smooth Boot 让游戏加载时不再卡死；Dynamic FPS 自动降低后台帧率，省电又降温。FancyMenu 自定义的主菜单不仅美观，更直接显示版本信息和作者署名，让你知道自己在用什么。

配置文件的每一处调整都有文档记录。不想用某个功能？README 里详细说明了每个模组的作用和禁用方法。遇到问题？日志文件和崩溃报告的位置都写清楚了。

**English:**
From launch to gameplay, every step is polished. ModernFix and LazyDFU cut startup time in half; Smooth Boot prevents freezing during loading; Dynamic FPS automatically reduces background frame rate, saving power and reducing heat. The FancyMenu-customized main menu isn't just aesthetic—it directly displays version info and author credit, so you know exactly what you're using.

Every configuration tweak is documented. Don't want a specific feature? The README details each mod's purpose and how to disable it. Encountering issues? Log file and crash report locations are clearly specified.

---

### 社区与反馈 | Community & Feedback

**中文：**
清流不是终点，而是起点。我会持续跟进模组更新，测试新版本兼容性，根据用户反馈调整配置。如果你在某个场景下 FPS 不理想，或者有新的优化建议，欢迎反馈。下一版本可能就是为了解决你的问题而发布的。

感谢 Fabric 社区的无私奉献，感谢每一个开源模组作者，感谢 Minecraft 让我们相遇。愿每一块老显卡，都能在方块世界里找到新生。

**English:**
PROCESS isn't the destination—it's the beginning. I'll continue tracking mod updates, testing new version compatibility, and adjusting configurations based on user feedback. If your FPS underperforms in specific scenarios, or you have new optimization suggestions, feedback is welcome.
